span.p:
Type 1 · hypoxemic
no hypercapnia

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Type 2 · hypercapnic
COPD · cardiogenic edema
obesity hypoventilation

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ROX 4.88 or higher
HFNC is working

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ROX under 3.85
HIGH RISK OF FAILURE

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
no better in 1-2 h
pH still under 7.25
or worsening mentation

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: P/F under 150

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: P/F 150 or higher

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: yes

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: no

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Hypoxemic respiratory failure
SpO2 under 92% on room air

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NASAL CANNULA 1-6 L/min
each L adds about 4% FiO2
FiO2 about 24-44%

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
VENTURI 24-60%
or SIMPLE MASK 6-10 L
fixed, predictable FiO2

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NON-REBREATHER 10-15 L
FiO2 about 70-90%
this is the ceiling of low-flow

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Still SpO2 under 92%
on a non-rebreather?

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HIGH-FLOW NASAL CANNULA
30-60 L/min · FiO2 up to 100%
FLORALI 2015

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NIV / BiPAP
IPAP 10-12 · EPAP 5
titrate IPAP by 2 to Vt 6-8 mL/kg

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ROX index at 2 / 6 / 12 h
(SpO2/FiO2) / RR

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Continue · reassess
wean FiO2 then flow

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
INTUBATE
do not delay - late intubation
after failed HFNC/NIV = higher mortality

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LUNG-PROTECTIVE VENTILATION
Vt 6 mL/kg PBW · Pplat under 30
driving pressure under 15 · ARDSNet PEEP/FiO2 table
ARMA 2000

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
P/F ratio after 12-24 h
on PEEP 5 or higher

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PRONE 16+ h/day (PROSEVA)
+/- cisatracurium 48 h (ACURASYS)
conservative fluids (FACTT)

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Continue lung-protective vent
daily SAT/SBT · minimize sedation

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Refractory:
P/F under 80 for 6 h, or
pH under 7.25 with PaCO2 60+ for 6 h

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
VV-ECMO referral
EOLIA criteria · call the center EARLY
+/- inhaled pulmonary vasodilator as a bridge
